tasks.title: Set up or refresh ForgeCraft structural enforcement
tasks.description:
You are setting up ForgeCraft structural enforcement for **Chronicle Full Test**.

## Step 1 — Detect project state

Check whether `c:\workspace\claude\chronicle/CLAUDE.md` exists and has ≥ 300 non-empty lines.

- **New project (no CLAUDE.md or < 300 lines):** call `setup_project` to create all cascade artifacts from scratch.
- **Existing project:** call `refresh` to re-sync instruction files after any tag changes.

## Step 2 — Run the appropriate forgecraft action

**New project:**
```
mcp__forgecraft__forgecraft_actions
action: setup_project
project_dir: c:\workspace\claude\chronicle
```

This generates: CLAUDE.md (architectural constitution ≥ 300 lines), pre-commit hooks,
docs/diagrams/c4-context.md, docs/adrs/ stub, docs/use-cases.md stub, forgecraft.yaml.

**Existing project:**
```
mcp__forgecraft__forgecraft_actions
action: refresh
project_dir: c:\workspace\claude\chronicle
```

## Step 3 — Verify with the sentinel

After setup/refresh, call the sentinel to confirm state:
```
mcp__forgecraft__forgecraft
project_dir: c:\workspace\claude\chronicle
```

Write the sentinel output to docs/forge-status.md. This file is injected into every downstream task.

tasks.title: Complete the 5-step cascade and generate roadmap
tasks.description:
You are the architect for **Chronicle Full Test**. Your job is to complete the forgecraft cascade so the project is derivation-ready.

## Step 1 — Check cascade status

```
mcp__forgecraft__forgecraft_actions
action: check_cascade
project_dir: c:\workspace\claude\chronicle
```

The cascade has 5 required steps. All must PASS, WARN, or SKIP before implementation can begin:

| Step | Artifact | What it Provides |
|------|----------|-----------------|
| 1 | docs/spec.md (or PRD.md) | Functional spec with users, requirements, goals |
| 2 | docs/diagrams/c4-context.md | C4 architecture diagram |
| 3 | CLAUDE.md (≥ 300 lines) | Architectural constitution — operative grammar |
| 4 | docs/adrs/ (≥ 1 ADR) | Non-obvious decisions before implementation |
| 5 | docs/use-cases.md | Behavioral contracts + acceptance criteria seed |

## Step 2 — Close any FAIL or STUB steps

For each step that is FAIL or STUB, create or complete the missing artifact.
Use `generate_adr` for Step 4:
```
mcp__forgecraft__forgecraft_actions
action: generate_adr
project_dir: c:\workspace\claude\chronicle
title: <decision title>
context: <why this decision was needed>
decision: <what was decided>
consequences: <trade-offs and implications>
```

## Step 3 — Generate the roadmap (gated on cascade complete)

Once all 5 steps pass, generate the phased implementation roadmap:
```
mcp__forgecraft__forgecraft_actions
action: generate_roadmap
project_dir: c:\workspace\claude\chronicle
```

This produces docs/roadmap.md — a phased list of roadmap items (RM-001, RM-002, …).
Each item will become a bound session prompt in p2-build.

Write a summary of cascade status + roadmap to docs/cascade-status.md.

tasks.title: Generate session prompts and scaffold architecture
tasks.description:
You are the architect for **Chronicle Full Test**.

The cascade is complete (verified in p1-spec). Your job is to scaffold the architecture and generate bound session prompts for all roadmap items.

## Step 1 — Generate a session prompt for the architecture roadmap item

Find the architecture or scaffold item in docs/roadmap.md, then generate a bound prompt:
```
mcp__forgecraft__forgecraft_actions
action: generate_session_prompt
project_dir: c:\workspace\claude\chronicle
roadmap_item_id: <RM-XXX for architecture/scaffold item>
```

This returns a bound, self-contained prompt. Execute the work described in that prompt:
- Define module structure and boundaries
- Define port interfaces (repositories, gateways) — interfaces first
- Scaffold the project structure (directories, entry files, JSDoc stubs)

## Step 2 — Record architectural decisions

For each significant design choice, call `generate_adr`:
```
mcp__forgecraft__forgecraft_actions
action: generate_adr
project_dir: c:\workspace\claude\chronicle
title: <decision title>
context: <why>
decision: <what>
consequences: <trade-offs>
```

Then record it as a verification step:
```
mcp__forgecraft__forgecraft_actions
action: record_verification
project_dir: c:\workspace\claude\chronicle
tags: [project tags from forgecraft.yaml]
strategy_tag: UNIVERSAL
phase_id: architecture
step_id: adr-<decision-slug>
status: pass
notes: <one-sentence summary>
recorded_by: architect
```

Output: docs/adrs/*.md, src/ scaffolded structure

tasks.title: Implement features via forgecraft session prompts (TDD)
tasks.description:
You are the developer for **Chronicle Full Test**.

## Step 1 — Get your session prompt from forgecraft

For each pending roadmap item (implementation items in docs/roadmap.md), call:
```
mcp__forgecraft__forgecraft_actions
action: generate_session_prompt
project_dir: c:\workspace\claude\chronicle
roadmap_item_id: <RM-XXX for next pending implementation item>
```

The returned prompt is **bound and self-contained** — it embeds the spec constraints,
CLAUDE.md rules, acceptance criteria, and ADR context you need. Execute it exactly.

## Step 2 — Implement TDD (for each roadmap item)

1. Write failing test first (RED) — test is the acceptance criterion
2. Write minimal code to pass (GREEN)
3. Refactor against CLAUDE.md conventions (REFACTOR)

Use codeseeker to understand existing code before making changes:
```
mcp__codeseeker__search
query: <relevant concept>
```

## Step 3 — Repeat for all pending roadmap items

Work through RM items in order. For each one, generate_session_prompt → implement → verify tests pass.

Target: all roadmap items implemented with ≥ 80% coverage.

tasks.title: Run tests and score GS properties
tasks.description:
You are QA for **Chronicle Full Test**.

## Step 1 — Run the full test suite

Run: `pnpm test` (or the test command from CLAUDE.md)

Coverage must meet the target in CLAUDE.md (default: 80%).
Write any missing tests for uncovered critical paths.

## Step 2 — Score the 7 GS properties with forgecraft verify

```
mcp__forgecraft__forgecraft_actions
action: verify
project_dir: c:\workspace\claude\chronicle
```

This scores all 7 GS properties (0-2 each, max 14):
- Self-Describing, Bounded, Verifiable, Defended, Auditable, Composable, Executable
- PASS threshold: ≥ 11/14

## Step 3 — Record QA verification step

```
mcp__forgecraft__forgecraft_actions
action: record_verification
project_dir: c:\workspace\claude\chronicle
tags: [project tags from forgecraft.yaml]
strategy_tag: UNIVERSAL
phase_id: testing
step_id: test-suite-pass
status: pass   (or fail if coverage below target)
notes: <coverage %, test count, GS score>
recorded_by: qa
```

Do not proceed if tests fail or coverage is below target.

tasks.title: OWASP security audit
tasks.description:
You are the security reviewer for **Chronicle Full Test**.

Audit against OWASP Top 10:
1. Injection (parameterized queries only)
2. Broken Auth (token handling, rate limiting)
3. Sensitive Data Exposure (no PII in logs)
4. XXE / XSS (input sanitization)
5. Broken Access Control (ownership checks)
6. Security Misconfiguration (no default creds, security headers)
7. CSRF protection

Report findings with severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) to docs/security-audit.md.
Fix any CRITICAL or HIGH findings before allowing deploy.

## Record Security Gate

```
mcp__forgecraft__forgecraft_actions
action: record_verification
project_dir: c:\workspace\claude\chronicle
tags: [project tags from forgecraft.yaml]
strategy_tag: UNIVERSAL
phase_id: security
step_id: owasp-audit
status: pass   (or fail if CRITICAL/HIGH remain)
notes: <summary of findings>
recorded_by: security
```

tasks.title: Code review with codeseeker context
tasks.description:
You are the code reviewer for **Chronicle Full Test**.

Use codeseeker to get full context before reviewing.

Review for:
1. SOLID principles adherence (SRP, OCP, LSP, ISP, DIP)
2. CLAUDE.md conventions followed
3. No hardcoded values, all config through env vars
4. Error handling — custom exception hierarchy, no silent swallows
5. Test quality — tests are specifications, not just coverage
6. Orphaned code removed
7. All public APIs have JSDoc

Output verdict: ✅ Approved / ⚠ Changes Requested to docs/review-verdict.md

tasks.title: Deploy and close the forgecraft cycle
tasks.description:
You are the deployer for **Chronicle Full Test**.

## Step 1 — Deploy

Detect deployment target from project root:
- railway.json / railway.toml → Railway
- vercel.json → Vercel
- fly.toml → Fly.io
- Dockerfile → Docker / container registry
- package.json with publishConfig → npm publish

Run the appropriate deploy command. Verify the deployment is live.

## Step 2 — Close the forgecraft cycle

After a successful deploy, close the cycle to log S_realized, promote gates, and detect the next roadmap item:

```
mcp__forgecraft__forgecraft_actions
action: close_cycle
project_dir: c:\workspace\claude\chronicle
```

This call:
- Re-checks the full cascade (all 5 steps)
- Logs current S_realized to docs/gs-score.md
- Detects the next pending roadmap item (or marks the project complete)
- Promotes any conditional gates to permanent if S_realized ≥ 0.95

When S_realized ≥ 0.95, I(S) ≈ 1.05 — meaning ~1 iteration remaining. The project is in
sustained convergence. When S_realized < 0.95, the close_cycle output will surface the
roadmap items needed to close the gap.

## Step 3 — Update Status.md

Record: deployment URL, version deployed, S_realized from docs/gs-score.md, next roadmap item.
